subject.title: fix(node-host): preserve JSON parse error cause in decodeParams

question: Should maintainers require real node-host/gateway malformed-params proof before merging this protocol-visible `error.cause` change, or explicitly accept the current mocked handler/schema proof as enough?
rationale: The source-level fix is narrow, but external PR proof remains mock-only and the changed field crosses a strict gateway protocol boundary.

options.title: Require Real Boundary Proof
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, logs, or a reproducible transcript from a real node-host/gateway or CLI malformed-params run before merge.

options.title: Accept Mocked Proof
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly override the proof gate if same-version protocol behavior is considered low enough risk.

options.title: Avoid The New Field
options.body: Keep the diagnostic inside the existing message/details path if maintainers do not want to expand `node.invoke.result.error`.

recommendation.title: Require Real Boundary Proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, logs, or a reproducible transcript from a real node-host/gateway or CLI malformed-params run before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision is about the node-host/gateway invoke boundary that `steipete` introduced and refactored in the relevant history.
